page.overview:
Who is Brettner?

Admiral Brettner was a Starfleet flag officer in a fictional future created for William T. Riker.

In 2367, while exploring a cavern on Alpha Onias III, Commander Riker was rendered unconscious by gases. While unconscious, neural scanners scanned Riker's brain. The scanners used elements of Riker's reality and constructed a holodeck simulation with those elements interspersed throughout, so that it felt real to him. What Riker wanted, the scanners made possible.

In one of these simulations, Starfleet Admiral Brettner awarded a commendation for exceptional leadership to Captain Riker, of the , on stardate 57398, during the joint Excalbian Campaign. In 2383, this admiral was mentioned in Riker's service record that was on display in his quarters on the Enterprise-D. (, okudagram)
